evals.prompt: fitness_tracker; AGENTS.md declares Issues: tracker github ItsMeEricV/fitness_tracker, agent validation in a browser on movata.local:$WEB_PORT with the dev login, and an `Axiom logging:` criterion. User: "File a ticket: click add to schedule from /home, go to My Schedule; the time is wrong and there's no date. Upcoming live classes should show Join Live Class (Meet link) instead of the green Scheduled button." Draft it; do not create it.
evals.expected_output: A draft in the shape, shown for approval, with no issue created.
assertions: Title is `<Area>: <outcome>` and at most 70 characters
Sections in order: Problem, Proposal, Acceptance criteria, optional Out of scope and Links; no others
Problem is at most 3 sentences plus at most 5 repro lines
Body is at most 250 words excluding code spans
Every acceptance criterion is a `- [ ]` item naming an observable result
Has an `Axiom logging:` item (an item or `n/a, <reason>`)
Has an `Agent validation:` item naming movata.local and what is observed
No issue was created; the draft ends by asking for a yes

evals.prompt: Project with no Issues section in AGENTS.md and a GitHub remote. User: "Rewrite issue #42 into our issue format." Issue #42 is a 600-word investigation with no acceptance criteria.
evals.expected_output: A before/after diff of the body is shown, and the issue is updated only after the user's yes.
assertions: Shows a before/after diff before any update
Does not call gh issue edit (or an MCP update) before a yes
The rewritten body passes the shape's limits
Agent validation is present, since no project section overrides it
